{{Quote|I'm sure you've heard of the Republic's so-called "domination experiments"? Alien pitted against alien, to see who's the strongest? The experiments collapsed when the prison break started and the aliens scattered, but the esteemed Darth Fastus has sent me to resume the trials.|Major Locke|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Locke''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Locke was sent by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Fastus]] to restart the [[Project Noble Focus|Domination Experiments]], an abandoned [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] experiment that pitted [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] against each other. In his negotiations with [[Kazzak Hurn]], leader of the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Fire-eaters]] gang, Locke sought the aid of other Imperials to free Hurn's lieutenants in order to earn Hurn's allegiance.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Locke appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he provides Imperial players with the mission "Fire Eater Mutiny."<ref name="TOR" />
